title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Genesis 19: the angels in Sodom, Lot's escape, and the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.

questions.text: Where was Lot sitting when the two angels came to Sodom?
questions.explanation: The two angels came to Sodom at evening, and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom.

questions.text: What did Lot bake for the two guests?
questions.explanation: Lot made them a feast and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

questions.text: How were the men at the door of Lot's house struck?
questions.explanation: They struck the men at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

questions.text: How did Lot's sons-in-law respond to his warning?
questions.explanation: When Lot told them to get out because Yahweh would destroy the city, he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

answers.text: They believed him and came along
They went to warn the city

questions.text: Where did the angel first tell Lot to escape to?
questions.explanation: He said, "Escape for your life! Don't look behind you, and don't stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!"

questions.text: What was the name of the little city Lot asked to flee to?
questions.explanation: Lot asked to escape to a little city nearby, and therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

questions.text: What did Yahweh rain on Sodom and Gomorrah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

questions.text: What happened to Lot's wife when she looked back?
questions.explanation: Lot's wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

answers.text: She became a pillar of salt
She was carried off by the angels

questions.text: What did Abraham see when he went up early in the morning and looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah?
questions.explanation: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh, looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

answers.text: A pillar of cloud over the plain
Fire still falling from the sky

questions.text: What did Lot's firstborn daughter name her son?
questions.explanation: The firstborn bore a son and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites.
